annotation.title_clean: Canada – France Declaration on Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: Canada – France Declaration on Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
annotation.summary_en: Bilateral declaration by Canada's Prime Minister and France's President committing to safe, trustworthy, human-centred AI. It covers research cooperation, AI safety institutes, compute access, regulatory alignment, GPAI/OECD partnership, and coordination ahead of the 2025 AI Action Summit and G7 presidency. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commitment to safe, secure, trustworthy, human-centred AI aligned with OECD, Hiroshima Process and G20 principles
Collaboration on AI safety and evaluation between the AI Safety Institute of Canada and France's National Centre for AI evaluation
Joint AI research call funded by national agencies and consortia
Cooperation on alignment and interoperability of AI regulatory frameworks via GPAI-OECD partnership
Canada to co-chair global AI governance working group at the 2025 AI Action Summit
